@everyone

Cornucopians, 

Here is a breakdown of the sale tiers for the Valley Raceworx T3 sale on July 12th. Our goal is to provide as much balance and fairness to who has priority access to this sale and we based that on community activity and who has supported the project by holding a vehicle NFT. For anyone that is new to the project, you most certainly will have a chance in our public tier and IF you start claiming Corn Points NOW, you might be able to get a Corn Points Connoisseur role. Supply for each tier will be announced closer to the sale.

The policy is 1 NFT per person for the first 4 Tiers, then if any remain multiple NFTs will be available.

Tier 1 - Corn Points Whale (guaranteed mint) -  This tier can be purchased with the corn points you have claimed. The purchase price is 2750 Corn Points. This tier guarantees a successful mint for those who have followed directions carefully and ensured they execute a proper mint.  Purchase of this tier will close 4 hrs prior to the start of our OG Claim Event (that occurs on July 5th, time to be announced). NOTE: Corn Points are for the purchase of this tier access only. To mint a T3, you will need to show up to the sale with ADA in your wallet.

Tier 2 - Vehicle Holders (high chance mint) - This tier grants a high chance for a successful mint for anyone that has held at least one vehicle and has verified through our discord. Thank you for your support!  NOTE: to mitigate a pump and dump scenario for our vehicle collection, verification for this role will close in 8 hours. If you have not verified your vehicle through our discord verification channel, please do so NOW by visiting ⁠2│verify-your-asset 

Tier 3 - Corn Points Connoisseur (good chance mint) - For those of you who have been active on Discord, but have not been able to claim as much as you hoped. This tier can be purchased for 750 Corn Points. Purchase of this tier will close 48hrs prior to sale.

Tier 4 - Public (battle round 1 for the remaining supply!) - This role is open to the public.

Tier 5 - Public (battle round 2 for the remaining supply - if any are left!) - This role is open to the public.

IMPORTANT: Tiers are NOT on sale yet. We will announce that when the time comes

@everyone

Cornucopians,

IMPORTANT: Please read the following information carefully as we have made a few minor adjustments.


In the past, we've endeavored to make it easier for you all, mitigating the need to sit at your computer all day to mint, particularly if you're hoping to purchase multiple NFTs. We've been internally discussing an improved solution for this sale, and we believe we've found a fair and efficient approach that will expedite the process without necessitating a full day's wait to purchase a second or third NFT.

Here's the schedule for the tiers:

Tier 1: Corn Points Whale (must purchase to mint in this tier - 2750 Corn Points) - Opens on July 11th at 14:00 UTC and will stay open for 24 hours (ending at 14:00 UTC July 12th)

—30-minute break—

Tier 2: Vehicle Holders - Opens July 12th at 14:30 UTC and remains open for 20 minutes

—60-minute break—

Tier 3: Corn Points Connoisseur (must purchase to mint in this tier - 750 Corn Points) - Opens at 15:50 UTC and remains open for 20 minutes

—30-minute break—

Tier 4: Public - Opens at 16:40 UTC and remains open for 20 minutes

—30-minute break—

Tier 5: Battle for the Remaining Supply (IF any) - Opens at 17:30 UTC and remains open for 20 minutes

Finally, we've decided to remove the one-NFT-per-person limit for the sale. Those wishing to purchase more than one T3 vehicle will no longer need to wait until the last tier of the sale. Here's how this will work:

The new quota for each user will be three NFTs. While the maximum mint per tier will remain at one, should you make a purchase during one tier, you'll still be able to make a purchase during the subsequent tiers (if you have the required role) until you've reached your maximum quota of three for the sale. We believe this change will reward community members who wish to purchase more than one NFT.

Tier Purchases
For those of you that have been claiming your daily corn points, you can still purchase roles for Tier 1 and Tier 3. Head over to ⁠No Access to purchase, type “/buy” and choose the tier you would like to purchase.


Purchase of Corn Points Whale Role (2750 Corn Points) will close in 24 hrs. (from time of this announcement)
,
Purchase of Corn Points Connoisseur (750 Corn Points) will close 48 hrs prior to Tier 1 sale
